title: Amma Madad Karo
body:
Haye haye ali akbar..(3)
Haaye!!!
Barchi nikaal ne lage jab shah e karbala
awaaz maa ko deke ye mazloom ne kaha
hai aap ke hussain ki ghurbat ka imtehaa'n
<<MINI>>
Amma madad karo..
Kaise nikalu seena e akbar se mai sina
Amma madad karo..
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai aapke hussain ki ghurbat ka imtehaa'n
<<MINI>>
Amma madad karo..
Kaise nikalu seena e akbar se mai sina
Amma madad karo..
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Bardaasht kis tarha se ye kar payega hussain
bete ke saath dasht mein mar jayega hussain
kadiyal jawaa'n ragadta hai maqtal mein ediyaa'n
<<MINI>>
Amma madad karo..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Afsos aa na paaya mai usko utarne
zee'n se gira diya ise naize ke waar ne
tooti hai aap ki tarha akbar ki pasliyaa'n
<<MINI>>
haye, amma madad karo..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Akbar ke saath saath mera dil bhi chhid gaya
uth ta nahi hai haath tumhare ghareeb ka
pehle mere kaleje se tum khaich lo sina
<<MINI>>
Amma madad karo..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Paala hai jisne naazo se hai intezaar mein
chadar na bhool jaye wo akbar ke pyaar mein
zainab ko rok lo kahi'n aa jaye na yaha'n
<<MINI>>
Amma madad karo..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aati hai sharm baap ko bete ke saamne
aankho'n pe rakh do haath dikhayi na de ise
haye, rote za'eef baap ko dekhe na naujawaa'n
<<MINI>>
Amma madad karo..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Amma ghadi ye kaisi ajab imteha'n ki hai
do bekaso ke haath mein mayyat jawa'n ki hai
pehlu shikasta aap ka, meri kamar kamaa'n
<<MINI>>
Amma madad karo..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tooti hui kamar hai meri, mera saath do
mai chahta hu khaime mein akbar ko le chalo
zinda na dekh le ise, ek baar iski maa
<<MINI>>
Amma madad karo..
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Pohcha ke laash khaime takallum ki ye sadaa
zainab jo mujhse puchegi, kya mai bataungi
mujhse na hogi tum hi shahadat karo bayaa'n
<<MINI>>
Amma madad karo..
